themes.name: 20th Century Boys
themes.description: Rock saves the world. Kenji Endo, the Book of Prophecy, a childhood promise against the Friend's cult, and T-Rex echoing through history's darkest conspiracy.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: 91 Days
themes.description: During Prohibition, Angelo Lagusa witnesses his family's murder by the Vanetti mafia. Seven years later, he returns under a false identity to exact revenge — infiltrating the mob that destroyed his life.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: A Silent Voice
themes.description: Shoya Ishida bullied deaf classmate Shoko Nishimiya in elementary school. Years later, plagued by guilt and isolation, he seeks her out to make amends — and discovers the true cost of connection.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Accel World
themes.description: Bullied middle schooler Haruyuki is recruited by the beautiful student council vice president Kuroyukihime into Brain Burst — a secret game that accelerates time. His avatar Black Lotus hides surprising power.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Akame ga Kill!
themes.description: Country boy Tatsumi arrives in the capital seeking fortune and is recruited by Night Raid, a group of elite assassins using legendary weapons called Teigu to fight against the empire's ruthless corruption.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Amagi Brilliant Park
themes.description: High school narcissist Seiya is coerced at gunpoint into managing a failing amusement park inhabited by magical beings from a fantasy realm. With 100 days to draw 250,000 visitors, he brings ruthless efficiency to the rescue.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Ancient Magus' Bride
themes.description: Chise Hatori, an unwanted girl sold at auction, is purchased by the mysterious mage Elias Ainsworth who declares her his apprentice — and bride. In a world of magic and faeries, she learns the value of her own life.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Angel Beats!
themes.description: Welcome to the afterlife. A school beyond death where the SSS battlefront fights against obliteration, Girls Dead Monster plays on, and every soul finds its song.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: AnoHana
themes.description: Five years after the accidental death of Meiko 'Menma' Honma, her ghost appears to her childhood friend Jintan — the only one who can see her. She has one unfinished wish, and fulfilling it might finally let her rest.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Another
themes.description: Transfer student Kouichi Sakakibara arrives in class 3-3 to find a dark secret — the class is haunted by the curse of a dead student, and a girl named Mei Misaki seems invisible to everyone. The calamity is coming.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Ao Haru Ride
themes.description: Futaba Yoshioka lost her first love Kou when he suddenly moved away. Years later he returns — changed and distant. She reaches out to reclaim their connection, only to find a more complicated truth.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Ao no Exorcist
themes.description: Rin Okumura discovers he is the son of Satan himself — and after his guardian's death, vows to become an exorcist and defeat his own father. Training at True Cross Academy, he must hide his demonic flames.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Aria the Animation
themes.description: In a utopian future terraformed Mars called Aqua, Akari trains as an undine — a gondolier guide — in the Venice-like city of Neo-Venezia. The series is a quiet meditation on wonder, gratitude, and the beauty of everyday life.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest
themes.description: Average student Hajime Nagumo is betrayed and left for dead at the bottom of a deadly dungeon. Consumed by the abyss, he emerges remade — cold, merciless, and overwhelmingly powerful, determined to find a way home.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Heroic Legend of Arslan
themes.description: Young Prince Arslan of Pars watches his kingdom fall to the treacherous Lusitanian army — now a fugitive prince with a small band of loyal retainers, he must rise to reclaim his throne and create a truly just kingdom.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Ashita no Joe
themes.description: Joe Yabuki is a delinquent from the slums whose raw talent for boxing catches trainer Danpei's eye. His meteoric rise through the boxing world burns with fierce passion — and foreshadows a tragic end.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Azumanga Daioh
themes.description: A group of quirky high school girls — including child prodigy Chiyo, spacey Osaka, and catloving Sakaki — navigate daily school life with relentless absurdist humor that pioneered the modern slice-of-life genre.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Baccano!
themes.description: Prohibition-era New York, 1930s — immortals, alchemists, thieves, and railroad gangsters collide across timelines in a blood-soaked, darkly comedic mystery told out of sequence.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Baki the Grappler
themes.description: Baki Hanma trains obsessively to defeat his father Yujiro — the strongest creature on earth. He fights legendary martial artists across styles and genres in the most extreme combat tournament imaginable.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Banana Fish
themes.description: Ash Lynx is a beautiful, deadly street gang leader in New York caught up in a conspiracy around a mysterious drug called Banana Fish. His meeting with Japanese photographer Eiji changes everything.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Barakamon
themes.description: Calligrapher Seishuu Handa, criticized for being too textbook-perfect, punches a curator and is exiled to the Goto Islands. The island's warm villagers — especially a mischievous girl named Naru — teach him what real art means.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Battle Angel Alita
themes.description: Born from the Scrapyard, forged in Motorball. A cybernetic interface of Panzer Kunst precision, berserker fury, and the dream of Zalem.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Beelzebub
themes.description: Delinquent Tatsumi Oga finds a baby floating down a river — who turns out to be the infant son of the Great Demon Lord, making Oga his chosen human parent. Now he must raise the future King of Demons while navigating high school brawls.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Berserk of Gluttony
themes.description: Devour to grow stronger. A dark interface channeling Fate Graphite's insatiable Gluttony skill, soul absorption, and the hunger that consumes all.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Black Butler
themes.description: In Victorian England, twelve-year-old Ciel Phantomhive runs the family empire with his infallible butler Sebastian — who is not human, bound to Ciel by a Faustian contract sealed with a demon's mark.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Black Lagoon
themes.description: Salary man Rokuro Okajima is kidnapped by the Lagoon Company — a trio of mercs in a torpedo boat — and ends up joining them as they run guns, drugs, and worse through the criminal port city of Roanapur.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Blade of the Immortal
themes.description: A blood-soaked path of vengeance. Manji's cursed immortality, Rin's quest for revenge, and the Itto-ryu's ruthless ambition stain this interface in crimson.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: BLAME!
themes.description: Wander the infinite Megastructure. A cold, industrial interface forged from steel corridors, GBE precision, and the endless search for the Net Terminal Gene.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Blue Box
themes.description: Taiki Inomaki, a badminton player, falls for upperclassman and basketball star Chinatsu Kano. When they unexpectedly become housemates, their awkward coexistence slowly blossoms into an earnest romantic story.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Blue Lock
themes.description: Devour it all. A striker's interface forged in Blue Lock's ego-driven facility — spatial awareness, chemical reactions, and the hunger to become the world's best.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Blue Period
themes.description: Yatora Yaguchi is an excellent student with an empty life — until a single blue painting cracks him open and ignites a consuming passion for art. His desperate pursuit of Tokyo University of the Arts is a visceral portrait of obsession and creative suffering.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Bocchi the Rock!
themes.description: From hikikomori to guitar hero. Kessoku Band's hot-pink energy bursts across every stage, with Bocchi's heart-pounding solos and STARRY's spotlight lighting the way.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Candy Candy
themes.description: The irrepressibly cheerful orphan Candice White Ardlay grows up in a children's home, falling in love, suffering heartbreak, and spreading joy wherever she goes — in this legendary shojo classic that defined a generation.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Captain Tsubasa
themes.description: Tsubasa Ozora's dream is to win the World Cup for Japan. With the ball as his best friend, he overcomes rivals across Japan and the world through tireless effort and breathtaking technique.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Cardcaptor Sakura
themes.description: Release! Magical card-sealing aesthetics with Clow Cards wonder, star wand radiance, and Sakura's cheerful invincible heart.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Castle in the Sky
themes.description: A boy and girl with a mysterious crystal flee sky pirates and military forces to find the legendary floating fortress of Laputa — Miyazaki's soaring adventure of wonder.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Cells at Work!
themes.description: Inside the human body, trillions of cells work tirelessly. A cheerful Red Blood Cell delivers oxygen while a fierce White Blood Cell battles bacteria — together they keep the body alive.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Charlotte
themes.description: Some teenagers develop supernatural abilities during puberty. Yuu Otosaka abuses his for personal gain until he's caught and recruited into the student council that polices ability users — and learns of a darker truth.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Chihayafuru
themes.description: Chihaya Ayase discovers karuta — competitive card-matching based on classical poetry — and falls in love with the game. She forms a high school team to reach the national championship and reunite with her childhood friend.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Chobits
themes.description: Country boy Hideki finds an abandoned Persocom android in the trash — a mysterious girl-like unit with no memory named Chi. As he tries to restore her, he falls for her and uncovers a secret that changes everything.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: City Hunter
themes.description: Ryo Saeba is the City Hunter — Tokyo's best sweeper who'll handle any dangerous job, except his only weakness is beautiful women. Get Ryo Saeba on your side with a chalk message on the board at Shinjuku Station.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Clannad
themes.description: The place where wishes come true. A warm family-hearted interface woven with Dango spirit, Illusionary World light orbs, and the gentle cherry blossoms of Hikarizaka.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Classroom of the Elite
themes.description: Tokyo Metropolitan Advanced Nurturing High School rewards ability with points. In Class D — the lowest — Kiyotaka Ayanokoji hides extraordinary intellect, manipulating events from the shadows.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Claymore
themes.description: Silver-eyed warriors forged to hunt Yoma. An interface tempered like a Claymore blade — cold steel, relentless precision, and awakened power.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Cross Game
themes.description: Ko Kitamura grows up next door to the Tsukishima sisters — the bubbly Wakaba and the cool Aoba. After tragedy strikes, Ko and Aoba are drawn together through baseball and the promise left behind.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: D.Gray-man
themes.description: In a Victorian-era world ravaged by Akuma, the Black Order's exorcists wield Innocence to combat the forces of the Millennium Earl — Allen Walker's cursed eye sees the souls of the fallen.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Dandadan
themes.description: Aliens are real but ghosts aren't! Okarun and Momo crash headfirst into a supernatural world that defies all logic.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?
themes.description: Bell Cranel is a rookie adventurer in the city of Orario, aspiring to grow stronger after being saved by the beautiful swordswoman Ais Wallenstein — guided by the goddess Hestia, he navigates the monster-filled dungeon beneath the city.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Darker than BLACK
themes.description: Since the Heavens Gate appeared in South America, stars in the night sky are replaced by false points of light — and Contractors, people who gained special powers at a cost, battle in the shadows for intelligence agencies.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Date A Live
themes.description: Spirits cause massive spacequakes when they appear. Shido Itsuka can seal their powers — not by fighting them, but by making them fall in love with him. The only way to save the world is to go on dates.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
themes.description: Overworked programmer Suzuki Ichirou falls asleep and wakes up in a game world, inadvertently maxing out his stats with a meteor shower spell. Now exploring this new world as a tourist with godlike power, enjoying all the simple pleasures of life.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Devil Is a Part-Timer!
themes.description: Demon Lord Satan flees to modern Tokyo with no magic, forced to work at MgRonald's to survive. His hero-turned-coworker Emi tracks him there — as he discovers that conquering the fast-food world may be harder than Ente Isla.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Dirty Pair
themes.description: The Lovely Angels — Kei and Yuri — are top agents of WWWA who always solve cases with a 100% success rate, but somehow level a city each time. Officially: the Dirty Pair.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Dorohedoro
themes.description: Sorcerers and Hole dwellers in a gritty dance of smoke and chaos. Caiman hunts for his identity one head at a time.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Dr. Slump
themes.description: Norimaki Senbei creates the world's most powerful robot — Arale-chan — and somehow she's an innocent little girl who punches the Earth in half. Penguin Village will never be the same.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Dr. Stone
themes.description: 10 billion percent! After 3700 years of stone, Senku's Kingdom of Science will rebuild civilization using the power of human knowledge.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Dragon Ball GT
themes.description: When Black Star Dragon Balls scatter across the universe, Goku is turned into a child and must retrieve them before the Earth is destroyed — an unofficial but memorable final journey.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Durarara!!
themes.description: Ordinary high schooler Mikado Ryugamine moves to Ikebukuro and encounters a headless motorcycle rider, color-coded gangs, and an information broker who pulls the strings from the shadows.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: ef: A Tale of Memories
themes.description: Two intertwining love stories unfold in a coastal town — one about a girl who can only retain thirteen hours of memory, the other about a girl who abandoned her dreams for someone who never noticed.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Elfen Lied
themes.description: Lilium echoes through shattered silence. Diclonius vectors carve the dark, horns crowned in tragedy, as Lucy and Nyu drift between innocence and annihilation.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Vision of Escaflowne
themes.description: A girl, a destiny, a world of dragons and guymelefs. Gaean interface forged in fate threads, tarot visions, and Ispano craftsmanship.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Eureka Seven
themes.description: Teenage Renton Thurston joins the renegade group Gekkostate on the surfing robot LFO Nirvash to fight against the military, inspired by the mysterious pilot Eureka.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Eyeshield 21
themes.description: Shy Sena Kobayakawa's incredible running speed catches the eye of Hiruma, who forces him to become the Devil Bats' secret weapon. A reluctant hero grows into a legend on the American football field.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Fate/Grand Order
themes.description: Answer the call of Chaldea. Royal command seals, Noble Phantasm radiance, and the Grand Order to preserve humanity's future across Singularities and Lostbelts.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Fate/stay night
themes.description: Shirou Emiya is thrust into the fifth Holy Grail War — a secret battle where seven Masters summon heroic Servants to fight for the omnipotent wish-granting relic known as the Holy Grail.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Fate/Zero
themes.description: Ten years before the fifth Holy Grail War, the fourth war commences in Fuyuki City — a brutal conflict narrated with moral ambiguity, compelling Servants, and the tragic figure of Kiritsugu Emiya.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Fire Force
themes.description: Devil's Footprints alight. Shinra Kusakabe walks into the inferno to save humanity from the Infernals and uncover the truth of Adolla.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Fist of the North Star
themes.description: In a nuclear wasteland, Kenshiro wanders seeking Yuria — his fists strike the 708 pressure points of Hokuto Shinken, making enemies explode from the inside. You are already dead.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: FLCL
themes.description: Nothing amazing happens here. Screaming guitars, head-sprouting robots, Vespa-riding chaos, and the raw energy of The Pillows.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Free! Iwatobi Swim Club
themes.description: Haruka Nanase lives for the water. Reunited with childhood friends, Iwatobi High Swim Club competes with dreams, bonds, and the pure joy of cutting through clear water.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Fruits Basket
themes.description: Orphaned Tohru Honda moves into the Soma family estate and discovers their secret — members of the zodiac are cursed to transform when hugged by the opposite sex. A healing story of love and broken curses.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Future Boy Conan
themes.description: In a post-apocalyptic world reclaimed by the sea, a boy of incredible strength fights for Lana and a peaceful future — Miyazaki's first masterpiece of hope and adventure.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Galaxy Express 999
themes.description: Board the steam locomotive that crosses the stars — Tetsuro's journey for a mechanical body becomes a philosophical voyage across the galaxy with the mysterious Maetel.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Gantz
themes.description: You are dead. GANTZ has other plans. Don black combat suits and hunt alien targets before the clock hits zero.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Goblin Slayer
themes.description: A seasoned adventurer slays goblins — and only goblins — with ruthless efficiency. No quest too small, no goblin left alive. This is not glory, this is purpose.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Golden Time
themes.description: Law student Banri Tada suffers from amnesia after an accident, and in college he meets the vivacious Kouko Kaga — their college romance unfolds as Banri struggles between his past self and the new life he is building.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Goodnight Punpun
themes.description: Oyasumi Punpun. A bird-boy grows up in silence and sorrow — existential dread, first love, and the god who never answers.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Grand Blue Dreaming
themes.description: Iori Kitahara moves to his uncle's dive shop to start college life. His dream of a romantic campus lifestyle dissolves immediately as the Peek-a-Boo diving club drags him into nonstop drinking, nudity, and chaos.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Grave of the Fireflies
themes.description: Seita and Setsuko's journey through wartime Japan. Firefly lanterns, Sakuma drops, and the enduring light of memory in the darkest times.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Great Teacher Onizuka
themes.description: 22 years old. Former bike gang leader turned greatest teacher. Eikichi Onizuka takes on Holy Forest Academy's Class 3-4 with fists, heart, and a motorcycle.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Greatest Demon Lord is Reborn as a Typical Nobody
themes.description: Varvatos, the greatest Demon Lord in history, chooses to reincarnate as an ordinary person to experience friendship and connection. But his godlike power still leaks out, making a normal school life completely impossible.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Grimgar of Fantasy and Ash
themes.description: A group of strangers wake in the fantasy world of Grimgar with no memories. With no special powers or easy answers, they form a weak party and struggle to survive, learning the true cost of taking a life.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Mobile Suit Gundam
themes.description: The One Year War rages between Earth Federation and Zeon — aboard White Base, young Amuro Ray pilots the RX-78-2 and discovers that war is not about heroes, only people.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Haibane Renmei
themes.description: Rakka is born from a cocoon as a haibane — a being with small grey wings and a halo, living in a walled town with no memory of a past life. A quiet, spiritual story about guilt, forgiveness, and the day of flight.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Hajime no Ippo
themes.description: Makunouchi Ippo builds his strength from a bullied fisherman's son to Japan's featherweight champion. Every punch is fueled by dedication, heart, and the desire to know what it means to be strong.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Hanasaku Iroha
themes.description: City girl Ohana is sent to live with her estranged grandmother who runs a rural hot spring inn. Thrown into inn work, she discovers her own spirit through hard labor, unexpected friendships, and blooming love.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya
themes.description: The SOS Brigade awaits. A radiant yellow interface channeling god-like powers, closed spaces, and the endless eccentricity of Haruhi's world.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Hellsing
themes.description: The bird of Hermes is my name. Crimson-soaked interface channeling Alucard, the Hellsing Organization, and the eternal war against the undead.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Sound! Euphonium
themes.description: First-year student Kumiko Oumae reluctantly joins her high school concert band after an awkward middle school incident, but as the demanding conductor pushes the ensemble toward nationals, she rediscovers her passion for music.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Hidamari Sketch
themes.description: Yuno enrolls in an art high school and moves into the Hidamari Apartments, where she and her neighbors — Miyako, Hiro, and Sae — share cozy daily life while growing as artists.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: High School DxD
themes.description: Pervy high schooler Issei Hyoudou is killed on his first date — then revived as a devil by the beautiful Rias Gremory. Now serving in her household as a piece in the supernatural chess match between angels, devils, and fallen angels.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Higurashi: When They Cry
themes.description: Oyashiro-sama is watching. Crimson-drenched interface woven with Hinamizawa's endless summer, cursed loops, and the club's desperate struggle against fate.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Hinamatsuri
themes.description: Yakuza member Nitta finds a girl named Hina with psychic powers literally falling into his home. He grudgingly raises her as her adoptive father while navigating the chaos of her powers and her school life.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Holyland
themes.description: Find your Holyland. A gritty street-fighting interface channeling Yuu Kamishiro's midnight brawls, boxing stance precision, and the relentless pursuit of purpose in the neon-lit back alleys.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Homunculus
themes.description: Peer through the trepanation hole. A fractured interface of sand sculptures, distorted psyches, and Nakoshi's unraveling perception of the homunculi within.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Honey and Clover
themes.description: Five art-school students navigate the messy tangle of love, friendship, and creative ambition. Unrequited feelings and uncertain futures weave through their college years in this tender, bittersweet story.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Horimiya
themes.description: Popular student Kyouko Hori and quiet loner Izumi Miyamura each hide secret sides of themselves — when they accidentally discover each other's true faces outside school, an unexpected friendship blossoms into romance.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Hyouka
themes.description: The energy-conserving Houtarou Oreki joins the Classics Club to save his sister the trouble. Alongside the curious Chitanda Eru, every mundane mystery becomes a window into the human heart.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
themes.description: A lonely, bookish boy accidentally discovers his popular classmate Sakura's diary — revealing she is secretly dying of a pancreatic disease. He becomes her only confidant, and the two form an unexpected bond.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Infinite Stratos
themes.description: IS battle suits can only be piloted by women — except Ichika Orimura, the first and only male pilot. He enrolls in the IS Academy as the sole boy in an all-female school, surrounded by representatives from every nation.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Initial D
themes.description: Eurobeat never stops! Mountain pass mastery, drift techniques, and the legend of the Fujiwara Tofu Shop delivery driver.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Junji Ito
themes.description: Enter the spiral. Tomie whispers, Uzumaki coils tighten, Souichi grins, and the Enigma of Amigara Fault calls your name.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: K-On!
themes.description: Four girls with zero musical experience stumble into forming the Light Music Club. Tea, cake, and guitar solos carry them from school concerts to the Budokan — in their dreams and hearts.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kaguya-sama: Love is War
themes.description: Student council president Miyuki Shirogane and vice-president Kaguya Shinomiya are both deeply in love with each other — but too proud to confess, they scheme endlessly to make the other confess first in this battle of wits and hearts.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kaiju No. 8
themes.description: Kafka Hibino dreams of joining the Defence Corps to eliminate kaiju — but after a small kaiju burrows into his mouth, he gains the ability to transform into a kaiju himself, becoming Japan's most wanted mystery.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kamisama Kiss
themes.description: Homeless high-schooler Nanami is accidentally made a land god by a stranger. She inherits his shrine and his reluctant fox familiar Tomoe — who is proud, powerful, and slowly, unavoidably falling for her.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kare Kano
themes.description: Two model students — the perfect-looking Yukino and the cool Arima — discover each other's true selves, then fall deeply in love. Hideaki Anno's intimate romance masterpiece.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Katekyo Hitman Reborn!
themes.description: Tsuna Sawada is told he's the heir to the Vongola mafia family by Reborn — a baby hitman tutor. Forced into battles with dying will flames, the No-Good Tsuna becomes a true boss.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kengan Ashura
themes.description: In a secret world where business disputes are settled by hired fighters, ordinary man Ohma Tokita joins the Kengan matches for reasons of his own — devastating opponents with a unique fighting style called Niko Style.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kenichi: The Mightiest Disciple
themes.description: Kenichi Shirahama is a weak boy constantly bullied — until he trains under six eccentric world-class masters at Ryouzanpaku Dojo. Through brutal training and real battles, he becomes the mightiest disciple.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kids on the Slope
themes.description: Introverted classical pianist Kaoru moves to Kyushu in 1966 and befriends wild drummer Sentaro — through jazz, summer and hardship, an unlikely friendship and love story unfolds in postwar Japan.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kiki's Delivery Service
themes.description: Young witch Kiki sets off alone to prove herself, setting up a delivery service in a seaside city with only her black cat Jiji. A story of growing up and finding your own magic.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kill la Kill
themes.description: Ryuko Matoi transfers to Honnoji Academy seeking her father's killer, wielding a half-scissor blade and a sentient uniform called Senketsu — together they fight the tyrannical student council president Satsuki and uncover the truth of Life Fibers.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kimi ni Todoke
themes.description: Misunderstood Sawako Kuronuma, nicknamed Sadako for her resemblance to a horror film ghost, only wants real friends. When popular Shouta Kazehaya speaks to her, her world slowly begins to open.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kingdom
themes.description: Forge your path to Great General. Warring States command interface with Qin army discipline, battlefield strategy, and the dream of unification under heaven.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Kuroko's Basketball
themes.description: The phantom sixth man of the Generation of Miracles, Tetsuya Kuroko uses his misdirection to help Seirin High defeat his former teammates and claim the top of Japanese high school basketball.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Beyond the Boundary
themes.description: Akihito Kanbara is immortal and half-youmu. He encounters Mirai, a Spirit World Warrior who can manipulate her blood as a sword. Their unlikely pairing pulls them both into a dark conspiracy that threatens everything.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Legend of the Galactic Heroes
themes.description: An epic struggle between the Galactic Empire and the Free Planets Alliance, told through two military geniuses on opposing sides — Yang Wenli and Reinhard von Lohengramm.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Little Witch Academia
themes.description: Atsuko Kagari enrolls in Luna Nova Magical Academy inspired by legendary witch Shiny Chariot. Despite having no innate magic talent, her boundless enthusiasm and the Shiny Rod carry her toward something extraordinary.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Log Horizon
themes.description: When 30,000 Japanese gamers are trapped inside the MMORPG Elder Tale after a major update, strategist Shiroe and his companions must build a civilization and find a way to understand their new reality.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Lovely Complex
themes.description: Risa Koizumi is tall for a girl, Atsushi Otani is short for a boy — constantly mistaken for a comedy duo, their teasing rivalry slowly turns into something neither of them expected.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Lucky☆Star
themes.description: Konata Izumi and her friends navigate high school life with moe charm, otaku obsessions, and the eternal question of how to eat a chocolate cornet. Slice of life at its most endearingly absurd.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Lupin III
themes.description: Gentleman thief vibes. Globe-trotting heists with Jigen, Goemon, Fujiko, and Inspector Zenigata always one step behind.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Lycoris Recoil
themes.description: Former DA agent Chisato Nishikigi and reserved marksman Takina Inoue run the LycoReco café by day — and protect the city as elite Lycoris operatives by night, in a thrilling action series wrapped in cherry-blossom warmth.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Macross
themes.description: Giant alien war machines, transforming fighter jets, and idols whose songs reshape the battlefield — Macross is where love songs and dogfights collide across the stars.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica
themes.description: Middle schooler Madoka Kaname is offered a single wish by the alien creature Kyubey — in exchange for becoming a magical girl. But the truth behind the wish is far darker than she imagined.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic
themes.description: In a world of dungeons containing ancient treasures, young Magi Aladdin and wanderer Alibaba set out to capture the dungeon Amon — and are drawn into a grand conflict over the fate of the world.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Irregular at Magic High School
themes.description: In a world where magic is technology, Tatsuya Shiba enrolls as a 'Weed' — a second-course student — despite secretly possessing tactical genius and nearly unlimited power that defies the system's ranking.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Maid Sama!
themes.description: Misaki Ayuzawa is the strict student council president of a formerly all-boys school — hiding her secret part-time job at a maid café. When cool Usui Takumi discovers her secret, a charming rivalry blooms.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Maison Ikkoku
themes.description: Ronin student Godai falls for the young widow Kyoko, manager of the chaotic boarding house Maison Ikkoku — a slow-burn romance of missed moments and growing hearts.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Major
themes.description: Goro Honda loses his father to baseball but inherits his passionate love for the sport. From childhood to the major leagues, Goro's relentless drive carries him through injury, loss, and an unbreakable will to pitch.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: March Comes in Like a Lion
themes.description: Rei Kiriyama is a seventeen-year-old professional shogi player living alone, carrying deep loneliness and childhood trauma. The warmth of the Kawamoto family begins to slowly crack his isolation.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Mazinger Z
themes.description: Pilot the first super robot — iron armor, rocket punches, and photon energy against the armies of Dr. Hell. You are the devil or god — it is your choice.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Metallic Rouge
themes.description: On a terraformed Mars, Rouge Redstar hunts down rogue artificial humans called Neans who have inherited the godlike power of the Numina codes. A stylish neo-noir sci-fi thriller pulsing with chrome and crimson.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Mirai Nikki
themes.description: The survival game begins. Wield your future diary, outwit the other holders, and claim the throne of Deus Ex Machina — if Yuno lets you.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid
themes.description: Software engineer Kobayashi wakes up to find a dragon at her door — Tohru, who she drunkenly invited to be her maid. A quirky found-family grows as more dragons arrive in suburban Japan.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Monogatari Series
themes.description: Koyomi Araragi encounters apparitions — oddities bound to human emotion. Sharp wit, surreal architecture, and SHAFT's iconic visuals make each story arc a fever dream of words and weight.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Moribito: Guardian of the Spirit
themes.description: Balsa, a female spear-wielder with a vow to protect eight lives, becomes bodyguard to Prince Chagum — a boy who carries a water spirit's egg that the empire wants destroyed.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Mushishi
themes.description: Ginko is a wandering Mushishi — an expert in Mushi, strange life forms that exist on the boundary between the living and nonliving. Each village he visits holds a quiet, haunting story about the natural world.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Mushoku Tensei
themes.description: Jobless Reincarnation. Magic classes and deep worldbuilding. Earth brown & gold.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: My Dress-Up Darling
themes.description: Shy craftsman Wakana Gojou pours his soul into traditional Hina dolls — until radiant gyaru Marin Kitagawa asks him to bring her beloved anime characters to life through cosplay, launching an unlikely partnership.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: My Neighbor Totoro
themes.description: Two sisters move to the countryside and discover the gentle spirit of the forest — the great grey Totoro who only children can see. A tender Miyazaki masterpiece of childhood wonder.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: My Next Life as a Villainess
themes.description: Catarina Claes is reincarnated as the villainess of an otome game she played — destined for a bad end. Armed with foreknowledge and zero self-awareness, she accidentally charms everyone around her while trying to escape doom.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro
themes.description: Antisocial art-club loner Naoto gets teased relentlessly by the energetic, sadistic Nagatoro — yet she keeps coming back. Beneath her taunting is genuine affection that slowly draws him out of his shell.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Nagi-Asu: A Lull in the Sea
themes.description: Sea people Hikari and friends are forced to attend school on land when their underwater school closes. Torn between two worlds, they navigate first loves and an ancient conflict as winter threatens to swallow them all.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: NANA
themes.description: Two Nanas, one destiny. Punk rock attitude meets bittersweet romance in the neon-lit streets of Tokyo, powered by BLAST and Trapnest.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Natsume's Book of Friends
themes.description: Takashi Natsume inherited the Book of Friends from his grandmother Reiko — a ledger containing the names of spirits she subdued. He now works to return those names, guided by the curmudgeonly spirit Madara.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
themes.description: In a world consumed by the toxic Sea of Decay, Nausicaä rides the winds and seeks understanding between humanity and the giant insects — Miyazaki's ecological manifesto.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Recovery of an MMO Junkie
themes.description: Unemployed 30-year-old Moriko Morioka becomes a NEET and escapes into an online RPG, where her male avatar forms an unlikely bond with a guild member — unbeknownst to her, a surprising real-world connection lies beneath.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Nichijou
themes.description: Three high school girls live hilariously mundane lives alongside Nano, a robot who goes to their school, the young Professor who built her, and Sakamoto — a cat who can talk. Daily life has never been so dramatic or absurd.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Nisekoi: False Love
themes.description: Raku Ichijo made a childhood promise with a girl, holding half a pendant as proof. Years later, gang leader's daughter Chitoge enters his life — and they must fake dating to prevent a gang war.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: No Game No Life
themes.description: Blank never loses. A vibrant Disboard-inspired interface with game mechanics, Exceed strategies, and the Ten Pledges guiding every move.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Non Non Biyori
themes.description: City girl Hotaru moves to a tiny rural village with only five students at the local branch school. The slow-paced days of countryside living unfold with the gentle warmth of nature and the innocence of childhood.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Noragami
themes.description: Yato is a minor deity with no shrine who dreams of fame and worshippers, working odd jobs for five-yen coins alongside his human Regalia Yukine and school girl Hiyori, who can slip between the human and spirit realms.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Now and Then, Here and There
themes.description: A cheerful boy is swept into a post-apocalyptic hellscape of sand and war, where children are conscripted as soldiers. One of anime's most unrelenting depictions of human cruelty and the unyielding hope that endures through it.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
themes.description: Kim Dokja is the only reader of an obscure web novel called Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse — and when the world begins following the novel's plot exactly, his knowledge of the story becomes humanity's greatest weapon.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: My Love Story!!
themes.description: Gentle giant Takeo Gouda is intimidating but kind-hearted — always losing girls to his handsome best friend. When soft-spoken Rinko falls for Takeo himself, he can hardly believe he's actually loved.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU
themes.description: Hachiman Hikigaya, a cynical loner, joins the Service Club with the radiant Yukino Yukinoshita and sunny Yui Yuigahama. Beneath witty banter lies a genuine search for authentic connections.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Oshi no Ko
themes.description: Doctor Gorou Amemiya is reincarnated as the son of his idol Ai Hoshino, entering the brutal world of entertainment and vowing to uncover the dark secrets of the industry that shattered his new family.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Ouran High School Host Club
themes.description: When scholarship student Haruhi breaks an expensive vase, she's forced to join the Host Club — a group of rich, eccentric boys who entertain female clients. A reverse harem comedy with real heart.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Outlaw Star
themes.description: Chart your own course through the Toward Stars universe. Grappler ship combat, Galactic Leyline mysteries, and the outlaw spirit of Gene Starwind's crew.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Overlord
themes.description: Momonga's unmatched supremacy. Dark overlord black & bone gold.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Seraph of the End
themes.description: After a mysterious virus wipes out most of humanity, vampires emerge to enslave the survivors — orphan Yuichiro Hyakuya escapes and joins the Japanese Imperial Demon Army's Moon Demon Company to take revenge on the vampires.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Pandora Hearts
themes.description: At his coming-of-age ceremony, noble Oz Bezarius is cast into the Abyss — a dark realm of Chains and Will — and contracts with Alice, the Blood-stained Black Rabbit, to escape into a world of dark secrets.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Parasyte
themes.description: What is it to be human? Shinichi and Migi — one body, two minds — face alien parasites reshaping humanity from within.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Patlabor
themes.description: In a near-future Tokyo, giant construction robots called Labors have become commonplace — and so has Labor crime. The Special Vehicles Section 2 polices them with their own police Labors.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Perfect Blue
themes.description: Who are you? A fractured psychological thriller interface inspired by Mima Kirigoe's descent — shattered mirrors, stolen identities, and Satoshi Kon's masterpiece of paranoia.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Ping Pong the Animation
themes.description: Childhood friends Smile and Peco play table tennis together — one with innate talent he refuses to use, the other with passion that outpaces his skill. Their journeys intersect with rivals who reshape what winning means.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Plastic Memories
themes.description: In a future where androids called Giftias live among humans, Tsukasa works to retrieve them before their memories expire. Partnered with Giftia Isla, he learns that limited time only deepens love.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Pluto
themes.description: The world's greatest robots are being destroyed one by one. Steel-blue Europol investigation interface channeling Gesicht's pursuit of truth, the hatred that binds, and the fragile line between machine logic and human heart.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Porco Rosso
themes.description: A WWI flying ace cursed with a pig's face roams the Adriatic as a freelance bounty hunter in the 1930s — world-weary, romantic, and absolutely unmatched in the sky.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Prince of Tennis
themes.description: Prodigy Ryoma Echizen transfers to Seishun Academy and immediately dominates the tennis club. With fearless confidence and limitless talent, he faces opponents who push him toward his true potential.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Quintessential Quintuplets
themes.description: Genius student Fuutarou Uesugi is hired to tutor five identical quintuplet sisters — the Nakanos — who each resist studying in different ways, yet one of them is destined to become his bride.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Rainbow: Nisha Rokubou no Shichinin
themes.description: Seven young delinquents are locked in a brutal reform school in postwar Japan. They survive through loyalty to each other and their cellmate Rokurouta, building a bond that carries them through unspeakable hardship.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Ranma ½
themes.description: I don't need your help! Anything-goes martial arts chaos, Jusenkyo curses, and a dojo full of fiancées in Nerima.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Re:CREATORS
themes.description: Fictional characters from anime, manga, and games are pulled into the real world, and the creators who made them must confront their own creations as a rogue character called the Military Uniform Princess seeks to destroy reality itself.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Record of Lodoss War
themes.description: The cursed island awaits. Forge your path through ancient ruins, dragon lairs, and dark elf ambushes across the war-torn realm of Lodoss.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Rent-A-Girlfriend
themes.description: After being dumped, college student Kazuya Kinoshita discovers rental girlfriend services and hires Chizuru Mizuhara — a stunningly beautiful and professional companion with secrets of her own.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Revolutionary Girl Utena
themes.description: Shine forever! Rose Brides, impossible duels, and the enigmatic prince who may never arrive at Ohtori Academy.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Run with the Wind
themes.description: Kakeru, a former track star, is recruited by the oddly charismatic Haiji who needs ten residents of Chikusei-so to form an Hakone Ekiden relay team. Together, ten unlikely runners chase an impossible dream.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Rurouni Kenshin
themes.description: Dedicate the reverse blade to peace. Meiji-era aesthetics with crimson robe precision, sakura serenity, and Battōsai's restrained power.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: s-CRY-ed
themes.description: In the Lost Ground — a region cut off from mainland Japan — people called Alter users manifest physical manifestations of their psyche. Kazuma and Ryuho clash in an explosive battle of wills.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Saint Seiya
themes.description: The Bronze Saints fight for the goddess Athena in divine armor forged from the stars — their Cosmo burns to absolute zero and then beyond, smashing the speed of light.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Sakamoto Days
themes.description: Former number-one hitman Taro Sakamoto gave up the assassin life when he fell in love and started a family — but his past never stays gone, and now he fights to protect his beloved convenience store and even more beloved family.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Samurai Champloo
themes.description: If you don't like the hand that fate's dealt you, fight for a new one. Hip-hop beats, katana clashes, and the endless search for the sunflower samurai across Edo Japan.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: School Rumble
themes.description: Tenma Tsukamoto loves clueless Karasuma, while delinquent Harima loves Tenma who doesn't notice — a chaotic love polygon in the most hilariously eventful high school ever.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Serial Experiments Lain
themes.description: No matter where you go, everyone's connected. Dissolve into the Wired — Protocol 7, identity fragmentation, and the God that lives in the network.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Seven Deadly Sins
themes.description: Princess Elizabeth seeks the legendary Knights of Britannia, the Seven Deadly Sins, who were accused of betrayal and disbanded — only together can they confront the Holy Knights who have seized the kingdom.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Shaman King
themes.description: Every 500 years, a tournament selects the Shaman King who can commune with the Great Spirit and reshape the world. Yoh Asakura fights alongside his ancestor Amidamaru to claim the throne.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Shangri-La Frontier
themes.description: Gamer Rakurou Hizutome specialises in conquering terrible games — but when friends convince him to try the legendary full-dive VR title Shangri-La Frontier, he discovers a massive world with hidden depths no guide can prepare you for.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie
themes.description: Izumi is accident-prone and unlucky, but his girlfriend Shikimori is a perfect beauty who transforms into something dazzling when protecting him. Their sweet relationship proves that cool and cute go together.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Skip and Loafer
themes.description: Optimistic small-town girl Mitsumi Iwakura moves to Tokyo to chase her ambitious life plan, and through a stumble on her first day of high school she befriends the effortlessly popular Sousuke Shima, beginning a warm coming-of-age story.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Skip Beat!
themes.description: Kyoko Mogami follows her childhood friend Sho to Tokyo to support his music career — only to be discarded and publicly humiliated. Burning with revenge, she enters the entertainment industry to destroy him.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
themes.description: Rimuru's nation-building. Benevolent Demon Lord in teal & blue slime.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Soul Eater
themes.description: At the Death Weapon Meister Academy, meisters and their weapon partners train to fight evil souls. Maka and Soul Eater aim to make Soul a Death Scythe by collecting 99 evil souls and one witch soul.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Space Battleship Yamato
themes.description: The legendary battleship rises from the ocean floor to sail the stars — one year to reach Iscandar, one mission to save a dying Earth. Launch the Wave-Motion Gun.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Space Brothers
themes.description: As children, brothers Mutta and Hibito promised to become astronauts. Hibito makes it to the moon — but Mutta, now 32 and unemployed, must restart his dream from scratch and catch up to his younger brother.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Summer Wars
themes.description: Math genius Kenji is tricked into attending his classmate Natsuki's grandmother's 90th birthday as her fake fiancé. When a rogue AI threatens to destroy the virtual world OZ — and reality — the whole family must unite.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Suzume
themes.description: Suzume follows a handsome young man through a mysterious door that appears in ruins across Japan. Pulling out a magical key releases disasters — and she must travel the country closing doors before catastrophe strikes.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Teasing Master Takagi-san
themes.description: Middle schooler Nishikata vows to get back at his classmate Takagi, who teases him mercilessly. But she always reads him perfectly — and her gentle teasing hides feelings deeper than either will admit.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Tamako Market
themes.description: Tamako Kitashirakawa lives in a shopping district and helps at her family's mochi shop. One day a plump, talking bird named Dera arrives — claiming to be searching for a bride for a prince — and disrupts everything.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Tatami Galaxy
themes.description: A nameless college student relives his two-year college experience across parallel realities, each time joining a different club — desperately seeking the 'rose-colored campus life' he keeps squandering.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Texhnolyze
themes.description: In the underground city of Lux, fighter Ichise loses his arm and leg in a brutal punishment — then receives texhnolyze cybernetic replacements. He is drawn into a brutal war between factions in a dying city.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Eminence in Shadow
themes.description: Reincarnated as Cid Kagenou, a boy obsessed with becoming an all-powerful shadowy mastermind, he creates a fictional organisation called Shadow Garden — only to discover it's fighting a real ancient evil.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Rising of the Shield Hero
themes.description: Wrongly accused and betrayed on his first day as a summoned hero, Naofumi Iwatani is left with only his shield and his rage. Rising from disgrace, he forges his own path — building a party, earning trust, and fighting for a world that doubted him.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: To Your Eternity
themes.description: An immortal being cast upon the Earth takes the form of a rock, then moss, then a dying wolf, and finally a lonely boy — beginning an eternal journey of loss, love, and the search for what it means to be alive.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Tokyo Ghoul:re
themes.description: The world of :re awakens. CCG operations, Quinx kagune, and the Dragon's shadow across a teal-blue investigation interface.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Tokyo Revengers
themes.description: Takemichi Hanagaki leaps back in time to save his first love from a brutal gang. Racing through the violent world of the Tokyo Manji Gang, every choice reshapes the future.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Toradora!
themes.description: The Palm-top Tiger and the delinquent. Orange & cyan romance.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Toriko
themes.description: In a world where the best flavours of nature are the ultimate prize, the Gourmet Hunter Toriko ventures into the most dangerous wildernesses to capture legendary ingredients for his ever-growing Full Course Menu.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Touch
themes.description: Twins Tatsuya and Kazuya Uesugi are next-door neighbors with Minami, the girl they both love. Kazuya dreams of taking Minami to Koshien — until tragedy forces Tatsuya to carry that dream in his brother's place.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Tower of God
themes.description: Enter as an Irregular. Shinsu-infused interface forged through Tower tests, Ranker ambition, and Bam's unwavering ascent toward the summit.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Trigun Stampede
themes.description: Vash the Stampede wanders a desert wasteland planet with a $$60 billion bounty on his head, spreading love and peace while somehow surviving every catastrophe he attracts. TRIGUN STAMPEDE reimagines this classic with stunning modern animation.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Trigun
themes.description: Love and Peace! Wander the scorched wastes of No-Man's Land with the $$60 billion outlaw — guns, grit, and a smile that hides the storm.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Twelve Kingdoms
themes.description: Ordinary schoolgirl Yoko is suddenly transported to a mysterious world of twelve kingdoms where she must survive, grow, and eventually become a true ruler worthy of the throne.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Urusei Yatsura
themes.description: The world's unluckiest lecher Ataru Moroboshi must now live with Lum, the adorable horned alien oni who fell in love with him — zapping him is her love language.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Uzumaki
themes.description: The spiral curse of Kurôzu-cho consumes all. Kirie, Shuichi, snail people, the lighthouse, and Junji Ito's spiraling horror made manifest.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Vagabond
themes.description: Invincible under heaven. Follow Miyamoto Musashi's path of relentless self-mastery through feudal Japan's duels, ink-brushed landscapes, and the Way of the Sword.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The Way of the Househusband
themes.description: The legendary yakuza Tatsu, feared as the Immortal Dragon, abruptly retires to become a devoted househusband for his career-driven wife. He applies the same intense yakuza intensity to cooking, cleaning, and shopping.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Weathering with You
themes.description: Runaway Hodaka arrives in a rain-drenched Tokyo and meets Hina, a girl who can stop the rain and bring sunshine. As they build a life together, he must choose between the girl he loves and the world's weather.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Welcome to the NHK
themes.description: Tatsuhiro Satou is a hikikomori convinced a conspiracy called NHK is ruining his life. When a mysterious girl named Misaki knocks on his door offering help, his shut-in existence is slowly, painfully dismantled.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Whisper of the Heart
themes.description: Bookworm Shizuku keeps finding books that were checked out by someone named Seiji Amasawa — then they meet, and discover they share the same dreams of becoming creators.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Wind Breaker
themes.description: Loner Haruka Sakura transfers to Furin High — a school of delinquents who secretly protect their town from outside threats, clashing with gangs and building bonds through street brawls and unbreakable loyalty.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Wolf Children
themes.description: A college student falls in love with a wolf-man and bears two children — Ame and Yuki — who can transform between human and wolf form. After their father's death, she raises them alone in the mountains.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Wolf's Rain
themes.description: In a world where wolves are thought to be extinct, a pack of wolves disguised as humans searches for Paradise — a legendary land promised at the end of the world.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: The World God Only Knows
themes.description: Keima Katsuragi is the God of Conquest in galge games — and is contractually forced to conquer real girls to drive out demons hidden in their hearts. The only problem: real girls don't follow game logic.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku
themes.description: Office worker Narumi Momose is a closeted fujoshi who reunites with childhood friend and hardcore gamer Hirotaka Nifuji — they decide to date despite both being otaku, leading to an endearingly awkward workplace romance.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Your Lie in April
themes.description: Piano prodigy Kousei Arima lost his ability to hear music after his mother's death, until free-spirited violinist Kaori Miyazono crashes into his life and drags him back into the colorful world of music and emotion.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Yowamushi Pedal
themes.description: Otaku Sakamichi Onoda commutes 45km to school on a mamachari to get to Akihabara. Discovered by cycling enthusiasts, he joins the road racing club and his incredible natural climbing ability astounds everyone.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Yuri!!! on ICE
themes.description: After a humiliating defeat, figure skater Yuri Katsuki finds himself coached by his idol Victor Nikiforov. On the ice, they carve a story of love, rivalry, and transcendent performance.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Laid-Back Camp
themes.description: Rin Shima loves solo camping under Mount Fuji's glow. When she meets the enthusiastic Nadeshiko, their peaceful camp nights spark an unlikely club and a journey through Japan's beautiful wilderness.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Yu Yu Hakusho
themes.description: Spirit Gun! Underworld aesthetics with spirit detective swagger, Dark Tournament fury, and demon world power.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Zatch Bell!
themes.description: Kiyo Takamine is paired with the amnesiac Zatch Bell, a mamodo child who shoots lightning from his mouth. Together they must fight other mamodo-human pairs to determine who will become the King of the Mamodo World.
themes.author: seanime

themes.name: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
themes.description: After years of soul-crushing work, Akira Tendo wakes up to find the world overrun by zombies — and realises with joy that he never has to go to work again. He sets out to complete 100 things before becoming a zombie himself.
themes.author: seanime
